newsitem.title: CHINA: Willis Corroon opens Shanghai branch.
newsitem.headline: Willis Corroon opens Shanghai branch.

text.p: International insurance broker Willis Corroon Group Plc has expanded its presence in China by opening a branch office in Shanghai, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The office was set up two years after Willis Corroon established its first office in the Chinese capital Beijing, the agency said.
The group planned to set up branch offices in all China's economic centres over the next few years, it quoted a company official as saying but gave no details.
China has been reluctant to open much of its insurance market to foreign companies, saying that domestic insurers need more time to prepare for increased competition.
